methodologyNotes: The roster covers twelve fuel-burning portable generators (inverter and conventional), excluding battery-only power stations. Specs independently re-verified against manufacturer product pages (Honda, Westinghouse, DuroMax, Pulsar, Champion, Briggs & Stratton, WEN, Generac, Harbor Freight/Predator), generatorbible.com, and major retailers (Norwall, webstaurantstore, Electric Generator Depot). Prices reflect published US MSRP or the lowest verified retail price at time of research. Running watts are continuous rated output on gasoline; peak/starting watts are the surge figure on gasoline. Noise is dBA at stated load (mfr spec); weight is dry weight in pounds. Discontinued models are flagged in priceNote; where a manufacturer does not publish noise dBA it is null. Two outlet-list fabrications were corrected during fact-check (see provenance on DuroMax XP13000EH and Predator 3500). accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: Honda EU2200i
products.priceNote: $1,199 lowest verified retail (multiple major retailers); original launch MSRP was $1,149.95
products.provenance: Price $1,199 (lowest verified across Camping World/Walmart/Northern Tool per generatorbible); 1800/2200W, 48 dBA at 1/4 load, 47.4 lb, 8.1 hr at 25% load all confirmed. Honda direct store page returned 403 so source switched to generatorbible (primary spec aggregator). Release year 2018 confirmed: announced Dec 14 2017, available spring 2018 per Honda press release.

products.name: Westinghouse iGen4500
products.priceNote: webstaurantstore listed $999; norwall listed $1,049; model largely discontinued at retail
products.provenance: Price $999, 3700/4500W, 52 dBA, 127.6 lb, 18 hr at 25% load, and outlet config confirmed directly from cited webstaurantstore product page. Release year not found in any source; left null.

products.name: Champion 100302

products.name: Generac GP3000i
products.priceNote: Original MSRP $799; model discontinued, replaced by GP3300i
products.provenance: 2300/3000W, 59.5 lb, 5.8 hr at 25% load, outlets (duplex 5-20R, L5-30R, 2×USB) confirmed from generatorbible. Generac does not publish a noise dBA figure for this model (explicitly stated on source); noise_dba null. MSRP $799 confirmed. Discontinued, replaced by GP3300i.

products.name: DuroMax XP13000EH
products.priceNote: Regular price on duromaxpower.com; frequently on sale lower
products.provenance: 10,500W (gas) / 13,000W peak, dual fuel, 234 lb, 74 dBA, 8 hr at 50% on gas confirmed from DuroMax and generatorbible. MSRP $1,699 confirmed. CORRECTED OUTLETS: draft claimed '1×USB-A, 1×USB-C'; generatorbible confirms only 1×5V USB (standard USB-A). USB-C removed as fabrication.

products.name: WEN 56380i
products.priceNote: MSRP from wenproducts.com; frequently discounted to ~$549
products.provenance: 3400/3800W, 57 dBA at 1/4 load, 99.2 lb, 8.5 hr at 50% load confirmed from WEN official page. MSRP $799.99 and outlet list (incl. 2×5V USB) confirmed directly from wenproducts.com. Release year not published.

products.name: Predator 3500 (Item 71358)
products.priceNote: Regular price at Harbor Freight; frequent coupon pricing $599.99
products.provenance: 3000/3500W, 56 dBA, 102 lb, 11 hr at 25% load confirmed. Regular price $799.99 confirmed via Harbor Freight 2026 coupon ($599.99 sale). CORRECTED OUTLETS: draft listed BOTH an onboard L5-30R and an onboard TT-30R; the 30A RV (TT-30R) is an INCLUDED ADAPTER, not an onboard receptacle. Onboard panel has one 120V 30A L5-30R twist-lock + two 120V 20A household + 12V DC + USB. Removed fabricated onboard TT-30R.
